name: Spinner
description: Indeterminate loading spinner for async UI.

size.forwardedTo: CSS module size classes on Spinner.module.css

a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-05-28 — Promoted from alpha: Example + ForcedColors stories present; Storybook axe gate enabled. 2026-07-03 (batch 4) — BusyIndicator deleted (duplicate loading indicator with off-convention s/m/l sizes); its consumers migrated here.

forbiddenUse: leave a spinner running past a couple of seconds without escalating; long waits need Progress or a Skeleton layout.
render more than one spinner per region; wrap the whole region in a single status instead.
prefersOver: Progress for measurable or long-running work
dense: bare indeterminate ring (role=status, aria-label); sm/md/lg; for sub-second unknown waits — Progress for known/long work, Skeleton for layouts

usage.description: Spinner is the smallest loading primitive: a bare animated ring with role=status and an accessible label, sized to sit inline next to inputs, inside buttons, or centered in a small region. Use it for short waits of unknown duration (roughly a second or less). When completion is measurable or the wait is long, use Progress; when a layout is loading, mirror it with Skeleton. It renders no visible text — compose one alongside when sighted users also need the word.

bestPractices.description: Name the wait in the label prop ("Validating password", not "Loading") — it is the accessible name AT users hear.
Match size to the host control: sm inside inputs and buttons, md standalone, lg for region-level waits.
Compose a visible Text label alongside for waits sighted users watch (see AppLoading); mark the visible copy aria-hidden so the announcement is single.
Swap the spinner for a concrete outcome (success icon, error text) as soon as the wait resolves — do not leave it as the end state.
Do not use Spinner for waits you can measure or that routinely exceed a couple of seconds — that is Progress territory.
Do not scatter one spinner per element while a view loads; use a Skeleton layout or one region-level spinner.
